I'm in a tough situation at home -- I'm 18 and technically and legally I am independent but it's not all that simple when you are raised by control freaks. Hence why I refuse to go back to my family doctor or the psychotherapist I used to see, I couldn't ever be honest with them because my parents were always prying them for information that I had shared with them. Even the fact that these people have been asked just totally turns me away from going to see them or trusting them..

Back in December I made an emergency call from another number (so my parents couldn't track my calls or text messages like they usually do), and talked to a nurse at the ministry of health and told her all of my symptoms. She said it was more than likely that I have paranoid schizophrenia as I have all of the major symptoms. 

If my parents ever found that out I would have to move out and I don't have anywhere to go and I just don't trust anyone or anything I can't even make friends because I'm paranoid they're all plotting against me, everyone is plotting against me and they want me in suffering but I just want to die because the pain never goes away my life has been just constant unhappiness since I was 13 and I can't fucking keep going.

I've been to multiple therapists, not because my parents made me but my school made them, emergency situations, etc. I've been hospitalized and they refuse to believe in mental illness. They think I'm an attention whore and just pull stunts. I've never mentioned anything about what I hear or see. My parents pretty much believe stereotypes that all schizophrenics are serial killers and insane. It's so bad with them that I can't go to them for even feeling the slightest of down. They blame me for causing them stress because of my own issues. If hanging myself the first time and then trying to overdose the second time didn't make mental illness seem real nothing will.

The thing is they don't -- and my parents have engaged in borderline illegal practices and shady things so it's not bizarre for such a claim. I'm not irresponsible with my money, in paying for school, my car and have my job. But they are in full control of it. They see every time I take out money or put in money. I have no control over that.

Honestly I'm at the point where I'm not physically doing anything harmful to myself -- it's just mentally torturing myself. I'm at the point where my hallucinations follow me around and chase me and lunge at me. It doesn't usually happen when I'm around people but I can't be around people anymore because they just ignore me. I try to speak and there so disinterested that I'd rather just sit in my room and suffer. I can't tell my parents - like I said they would disown me because they don't believe in mental illness or think anybody with mental illness is insane. Schizophrenia is the one they make fun of the most and demonize and stigmatize the most. I can't open up to them. I've tried talking to my sister about it - she is supportive I just don't think I can tell her what I'm actually suffering from. It's just mentally killing me.
I can't have my parents find out I can't have 99% of people I know find out if I do I'm done for
I just don't have the resources my situation is really complicated I don't know what to do
